article.title: No refund if paid voluntarily.
article.content: When an executor or administrator has voluntarily paid a legacy, he cannot call upon a legatee to refund in the event of the assets proving insufficient to pay all the legacies.
article.html:
357No refund if paid voluntarily.

Section 357 · Part IX · Chapter XII · page 90 of the Act

When an executor or administrator has voluntarily paid a legacy, he cannot call upon a legatee to refund in the event of the assets proving insufficient to pay all the legacies.
